name: ATC Energies System Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2020, ATC Energies System Limited is a company that operates in the energy sector, focusing on providing energy solutions, products, and services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
ATC Energies System Limited is engaged in producing and supplying lithium-ion batteries. The company provides efficient and cost-effective energy storage solutions across various industries, including banking, automobiles, industrial applications, and technology.  
Product Portfolio  [1]
The company manufactures lithium-ion batteries of different sizes for various applications:
- Mini (≤100Wh) – Used in POS machines, ATMs, and small-scale electronics.
a) Small (101-750Wh) – Used in drones, robotics, industrial weighing scales, and electric vehicles.
b) Medium (751-2000Wh) – Used in electric vehicles, UPS inverters, and energy storage systems.
c) Large (>2000Wh) – Used in industrial applications, grid storage, and heavy-duty equipment.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.88 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.8%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 172 days.
